versions.content: Shall be able to express information about the state of model elements Type: valid Description: It would be beneficial, if the STDT would also support information about the state of model elements. Example: Due to backward compatibility it will be difficult to delete exiting application interfaces for future releases. If some of the model elements are no longer ”state of the art”, they can be marked as being e.g. ”obsolete”. Rationale: This supports a continues evolution of a standard Use Case: [UC_STDT_00001] Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
